description: Simple Minecraft mod that makes anything with a durability simply not break, and sit uselessly in your inventory or container waiting to be repaired/recharged.

mods.name: Keep Broken
mods.description: Items with durability no longer vanish at zero. They stay in your inventory, unusable, until repaired.

releases.notes:
Does what it says on the tin. Always irked me that weapons and tools just... vanish when they're used up. Imagine if you had a screwdriver that just BAMF'd away after you turned it like 250 times? So, if you have an item that has durability, and that durability hits zero, the item will not break. It'll be completely useless until repaired/recharged (cuz that's a thing some mods make happen, and I'm not cool enough to do anything more than a bandaid), but you will still have it. 

But King, you say, what if I don't WANT a bunch of broken tools, you say, cluttering up my inventory?

Well, I would reply, either chuck it in some fire/into lava/at a cactus, and get out of my house.

Full disclosure: Claude AI made this. I do not and cannot code. Anyone who wants to actually human-code this, please do! I'm just putting this here for anyone who might be able to use it, niche though it is.
